4a.explanationIssue: key matches the official answer but only if 'static array' means an ordinary fixed-size (automatic) array. A literal `static char a[N]` is zero-initialised, so under C semantics option g would hold. The explanation contradicts itself ('no element of a static array is initialised') and should say 'local non-dynamic array'.

4c.note: pointer difference of unrelated string literals is formally UB in C; result type ptrdiff_t (integer), so c is the intended answer. Optional note.

5.issue: 'Ah!' needs 32-bit AND an address below ~2^26 (64 MB). Clang -m32 prints Ah!, 64-bit crashes (both already noted). Missing: pow() is a double, so for x*x > 2^53 (address > ~94M) the result of (long long)(pow(x,2)-4)/(x+2) is s-1 in ~30-45% of random addresses (see verify/20B-B/refute_q5_precision.py), so even on 32-bit with ASLR the output is not guaranteed.
